script: She posted a photo? Stop being "one more" in her comments. Use one of these five, and she'll remember you. She gets the same comment again and again: "You're so beautiful." "So pretty." "Gorgeous." But a good compliment makes her smile, and she'll remember who said it. Number two: Some people look good in photos, others make the photo look better. I think you know which one you are. Number three: The most dangerous thing about this photo isn't how you look, it's the confidence you give off. You're praising something far more attractive. Number four: No wonder your camera's always in a good mood. Add a touch of humor, and it usually gets a smile. Number five: Everyone's looking at how you look, wondering what story is behind that smile. It skips the superficial and opens a more interesting conversation. The best compliments aren't the biggest ones. They show you paid attention. Now comment the word ADMIRE, and I'll send you the exact messages.
